free_tier.stated: no free GPU tier is published; on-demand rates per GPU-hour on the pricing page read on 2026-11-03: H200 141GB SXM5 USD 3.99, H100 80GB SXM5 USD 4.312, H100 80GB NVLINK USD 3.64, H100 80GB PCIE USD 3.5, A100 80GB NVLINK USD 1.57, A100 80GB PCIE USD 1.47, L40 USD 1.05, RTX 4090 USD 0.64, RTX A6000 USD 0.55. The page lists no L40S and no L4. Reservations are published beside each rate, from USD 2.919 (H100 80GB SXM5), USD 0.95 (A100 80GB PCIE) and USD 0.44 (RTX 4090). Per-minute billing; a top-up of at least USD 5 funds the balance.
free_tier.notes: the listed prices are all-in: vCPU, RAM and storage are included in the instance price

per_object_cap.notes: the ceiling is the instance shape listed beside each GPU, for example 24 vCPU, 225GB RAM and 4013GB NVMe for the H100 80GB SXM5

retention.notes: a machine record: storage is billed according to its state when an instance is not running

egress.terms: Data egress per GB is listed as FREE and data ingress per GB as FREE

interface_detail: inferred from the documentation index, which links an API documentation page; not probed
tooling: web console and an API documented at docs.oblivus.com/api/documentation; Ubuntu 22.04-based OblivusAI images preloaded with machine-learning tools
chaining: Published on-demand single-GPU rates for H100 80GB PCIE, A100 80GB PCIE and RTX 4090 with free egress make it a price comparison point for hosted GPU rentals; multi-tenant capacity is in Montreal and Oslo.
limits_note: No quota is stated: the page publishes per-GPU hourly rates and instance shapes. The prepaid balance, topped up from USD 5, is what binds.
binding_note: No quota is stated: the page publishes per-GPU hourly rates and instance shapes. The prepaid balance, topped up from USD 5, is what binds.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up asks for first name, last name, email address, password and country, a terms checkbox and a robot verification, then an email verification link. Balance top-ups start at USD 5 and the payment step is a redirect to Revolut or Binance; no phone or ID document is stated on the pages read. Whether the payment step needs a card is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The documentation pages read on 2026-11-03 are marked 'Last updated 1 year ago'; multi-tenant capacity is limited to two sites (Montreal, Canada and Oslo, Norway); H200 is by reservation request and GH200 by waitlist per the aggregator profile. No outage was observed.
